scripts.dev: npm run build:only && npx wrangler pages dev dist --binding IP_SALT=sal-local ADMIN_TOKEN=token-local
scripts.db:local: npx wrangler d1 execute steelback-leads --local --file schema.sql
scripts.db:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute steelback-leads --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name steelback-landing
